dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are distributed across the mid-to-posterior dorsal region. The most prominent structures exhibit a high-contrast transition from dark-valued exterior pixels to a light-valued ring, which then transitions back to a dark-valued interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of small, solid high-intensity white pixel clusters is concentrated along the lower lateral margin and the transition zone between the head and shoulder. These clusters lack internal gradients and present as localized, high-frequency noise-like patterns.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli in the upper-right quadrant form an irregular quadrilateral. A secondary set of smaller points along the lower lateral edge forms a roughly linear, longitudinal alignment.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp colorimetric boundary is present where the uniform, low-intensity dark pigment of the cephalic region meets the complex, high-contrast patterned texture of the thoracic and abdominal regions.
